article_notes: Drug-efficacy study of bruceine A against B. gibsoni (in vitro, and 3 experimentally infected beagles: 2 treated, 1 untreated control that reached the humane endpoint). This is treatment response in individual dogs (n=1 vs n=2), with kinetics shown only in figures; no marker is compared between severity or outcome groups. Not extracted under the treatment-response rule.
